'''Tony Reihl DSII/Luuke''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Tony Reihl]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14350">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14350 DSII/Luuke], DeckTech (Tony "Pallaeon" Reihl, 7 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14350/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14350/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018034400/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14350/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tony Reihl]]
* '''Published:''' 7 March 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''DSII/Luuke''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 BHBM Reihl DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Vision: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' turn luke to the darkside, but while you are waiting blow up stuff with the second Death Star.

The post also lists 1x Vision, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''DSII/Luuke'''
* '''Author:''' Tony "Pallaeon" Reihl
* '''Published:''' March 7, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 2.0
* '''Description:''' turn luke to the darkside, but while you are waiting blow up stuff with the second Death Star.

=== Strategy ===

start with Brin.../Take..... to get out Throne Room

and the effects, start with Endor so you can use Op..

as Planned.  Imediatly depliy Moff J. to get out sectors

while looking for Luke.
